attributes.action: Demand visibility of glucose levels on lock screens
attributes.background: Omnipod insulin pump uses a device to read and administer insulin. One crucial feature remains frustratingly absent: the ability to see blood glucose levels directly on the lock screen. This oversight of these devices increases the risk during emergencies and if help is needed.

rejection.details: Decisions about the features available on medical devices and mobile applications are a matter for manufacturers and software developers.
